verdict.rationale: Benchmark documents segmenting and filtering contacts and tagging subscribers on sign-up so they are segmented, which covers basic attribute- and tag-based segmentation. Nothing shows segments built from behavioral events or segments that update dynamically as data changes. Contact search by custom field (docs-2) is an API lookup, not a segment builder, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: behavioral-event segment criteria, evidence that segments stay live/dynamic as data changes, detail on combining attributes and tags into segment rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: Segment and filter contacts by what they care about.
Tag new subscribers on sign-up so they're segmented and ready to receive the right emails from day one.
